document_title: Associate fields with screens in Jira Cloud
content:
Summary
There are several options to find a screen to associate fields in Jira. The best option for you will depend on which screens and fields you're looking to update.
- To update screens, you must have Administer Jira rights
- The steps below are for Company-managed projects only
Solution
Update specific screens in a project
When we need to update specific screens, for example, just for the Create or the View/Edit screen from a specific work item type, the best option is to go directly to the desired project.
- Access Project settings
- Select Screens in the project settings navigation 
  - For Jira Software projects, this item is nested under the All work expander
  - On the Screens page, you'll see work item types and the Screen Schemes for each type - work item types can share the same Scheme, or have separate schemes
- Open the scheme that includes the issue type you're working with, and select the screen you want to update
- Add the field to the screen by searching at the bottom of the page. Ensure required fields are present on the relevant screens to prevent errors or unexpected behavior during operations involving those fields. 
  - If necessary, you can remove fields by hovering your mouse over them and selecting "Remove"
Select a screen from any project using global administration
By accessing the Settings Cog and selecting Work items, you'll be able to access the Screens menu, listing all screens across all projects in Jira.
From there, you can search by screen name and select any screen to edit the fields present on that screen.
Find a transition screen from the workflow editor
If your Jira instance uses transition screens regularly, it can be difficult to find those screens when you're looking to edit the fields on them.
- Access Project settings > Workflows
- Select Edit
- You can select a specific transition and from there see the Screen linked to the transition
Select the screen to be directed to the page to add and remove fields.
